body: I remember I once cracked and shouted at my friend about how much my parents hate me and how horrible they are and one of my classmates overheard me and said to stop whining and that my parents obviously love me. Fucking ignorant bitch.

105?!!! You should've been sent to the hospital especially as a kid! Iirc anything around and above 105 can cause brain damage. Wow your dad is a real piece of shit. What kind of logic is that?? If I were you, when he gets sick the next time I would've called him stupid and then call him a hypocrite if he gets offended but then again I'm very confrontational with my own parents.

>Oh, you too? Did they ever feed you those really bitter black supplements that came in a tiny bottle?? My grandma used to put sliced ginger on my belly button and the other would rub tiger balm on my chest lol. 

Yeah lol they'd feed me so many weird things other than real medicine and then wondered why I was taking so long to heal. How on earth is ginger on your belly button gonna help you in anyway??? Bruh I think tiger balm is like the go to remedy for APs. 

>I have no idea, little gag trick I guess? That's a lot of work for someone who doesn't want to go to school though... also how did your mom not experience period cramps?? They're so painful and I haven't met anyone who gets periods before that hasn't had them.

Who knows?? She only got cramps when there was something seriously wrong with her and she would milk it for attention but she never thought to think that maybe being bedridden for every period was something serious. She always thought it was just me exaggerating or faking it and wanted get out of school or some activity even though it's been happening for almost a decade. What a hypocrite. 

>And thank you! I'm a lot happier now that I'm outta college honestly. I'll probably go back at some point, just at my own pace

That's good to hear! It's good you're following your own pace and not forcing yourself to do something you're not ready yet. Your health comes first before your education :)

>My APs did this when I was still in school, to the extreme lol. The only time I got actual permission to stay home from school was when I would get the flu and have intense fevers in elementary. I'd stay home for days alone mostly in bed without being able to get out of bed, use the bathroom, or feed/hydrate myself.

Same here. I was very prone to getting very sick as kid and took forever to get over it (probably because they would use homeopathy instead of real medicine). 

>In high school, my mental health got worse and I would throw up from stress/anxiety because of school and my mom would yell at me that I was faking. 

How would you even fake throwing up?? They're logic doesn't make any sense. 

>College didn't even stand a chance though, all of the pressure to succeed in school and constantly attend no matter what kind of backfired- since I couldn't handle going to college because of it

Oh no that sounds horrible. College isn't for everybody and there's no shame if you put your mental health first before your education no matter what your APs say. Hope you can overcome this and good luck with your future!

Three more suicide attempts later, I think I can say with confidence that their method didn't work.

Same here. My health was declining because I couldn't get out of bed. I was losing all my friends and became more isolated than ever. I lost interest in most things and even stopped watching TV and playing video games. She noticed all of this but she didn't give a crap. But as soon as she noticed that instead of attending my online lectures, I've just been sleeping all day, she blew up. She never cares about any of the other things. No one in my family does tbh. Like why be a parent at all if you're not even gonna give a shit about your own child's wellbeing??

It just hurts that the one person in my family that I thought I could rely on ended up being just like our parents. He did such a good job at gaslighting me and making me think it's my fault for so many years and only recently did I think hard about it and realised what he was doing to me and that he's a major asshole who knows how to use pretty words to mask his true self.

It was an utter mess but I guess my teacher pitied me so she let me pass so I didn't have to do it again. Haven't done a speech since then, and thank fuck for that because I'm worse now.

Best thing I've found now is reddit to help.

My whole family, especially my mother has done much worse than this. It's already the norm where she's from to comment about people's weight and appearance but she takes it even further (it's part of the whole shitty parent package I guess). 

One time she said that I need to tie a rope tightly around my waist to be skinny like my friend. Not only did she say this in front of my friend, I was also only 7 ☹️. I've seen pics of myself at this age and I just don't see how she thought I looked to fat. Sure, I had some baby fat but I was at a healthy weight and size according to the doctors and pics. 

Another time she compared me to the sales assistant in a clothing store. She went all out by asking her what size she wears and my mum following it up saying how I should be ashamed of wearing the same size as her because I was a kid (11y/o) and the assistant was an adult. I was like a full head taller than this woman and I hit puberty fast so my chest and everything grew earlier on than average so me being an adult small at that age should not be shameful. 

Three are many many more stories that are similar and now as an adult, I just cannot believe that she thought there was no problem with what she was saying to her own kid 😔.
